coverage: 17 provinces and Vientiane Capital prefecture (18 first-level units), plus all 148 districts. Complete English/Lao names, explicit parent PCodes and 2024 LSB/UNFPA population projections based on the 2015 census. Every district code and parent matches the current population release; totals sum to 7,631,798. These are projections, not the 2025 census. Includes Xaisomboon/Xaysomboun and distinguishes Vientiane province from the capital prefecture. Geometry from the National Geographic Department / UNICEF via OCHA HDX,2019, reviewed2025; inland water excluded. Shared detailed borders follow existing China, Thailand, Vietnam and newly added Myanmar geometry.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
